cards.title: Welcome
cards.text: Welcome to Hotel Hoshi. The front desk is open 24 hours. Please ask us anything.

cards.title: Check-in
cards.text: Check-in time starts at 3:00 PM. Please tell us your name at the front desk.

cards.title: Checkout
cards.text: Checkout time is 11:00 AM. Please give your room key back to the front desk.

cards.title: Breakfast
cards.text: Breakfast is served from 6:30 AM to 9:30 AM in the restaurant on the 2nd floor.

cards.title: Dinner
cards.text: Dinner is served from 6:00 PM to 9:00 PM in the restaurant on the 2nd floor.

cards.title: Swimming pool
cards.text: The swimming pool is on the roof. It is open from 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM in summer.

cards.title: Big bath
cards.text: The big bath is on the 1st floor. It is open from 5:00 PM to 11:00 PM.

cards.title: Wi-Fi
cards.text: Free Wi-Fi works in every room. The password is printed on your room key card.

cards.title: Parking
cards.text: The parking lot is next to the hotel. Parking costs 1,000 yen per night.

cards.title: Towels
cards.text: Extra towels and pillows are free. Call the front desk from the phone in your room.

cards.title: Bags
cards.text: We can keep your bags at the front desk before check-in and after checkout.

cards.title: Lost and found
cards.text: If you lose something, ask the front desk. We keep lost things for one month.
